display.purpose: Module titles — one per screen, highest prominence.

label.purpose: Buttons, controls, nav rows, secondary list text.

figure.purpose: The single big KPI number a surface leads with.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action: Calm Blue fill with white text; Deep Calm Blue when white text needs 4.5:1 contrast. Radius 10px, padding 12px 16px, label typography.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4772fa; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Onest, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45; border: none; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3e64dc; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3e64dc; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Tinted filter/chip row: Lifted Surface background, accent text at the accent-text tone, hairline accent border at ~40%. Selected: Deep Calm Blue fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #1f232c; color: #7b9dfb; border: 1px solid rgba(71, 114, 250, 0.4); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Onest, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Signature component: horizontal rhythm of checkbox, priority signal (flag/dot), title, metadata. Priority via flag/dot, never card-edge stripe.
components.css: .ds-task-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: #171a21; border: 1px solid #262b36; }

narrative.overview: PulseFlow's design system is named for the day it serves. The owner of the deployment sits down with the product to capture a thought, place it on a day, keep a practice going, and read what the week actually looked like. The visual system exists to answer 'what now?' quietly and precisely, without narrating the process. Mood is calm plus precise: flat-tonal surfaces, restrained type, an accent that appears only when a decision is needed.
keyCharacteristics: The module title is always display type (Instrument Serif, 26px) — one per screen, no exceptions.
Body text always routes through a named role (app-body 13px → app-heading 15px → app-title 17px → app-display 26px); ad-hoc sizes are banned.
Depth is tonal at rest, never shadow-based for in-app surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; elevation is expressed through tonal steps (Night → Raised → Lifted) rather than shadows. Shadows appear only for floating overlays, which use the shadcn card/popover tokens.

rules.name: The Single-Source Rule
rules.body: Every product typeface and size routes through the @utility role set (app-display, app-title, app-heading, app-body, app-label, app-meta, app-overline, app-figure) or the shadcn primitives mapped onto those roles. Ad-hoc font-size utilities (text-[Npx], text-xs, text-sm) are banned from product surfaces.

dos: Do use the app-* role utilities (or mapped shadcn primitives) for all product typography.
Do keep the module title as display type and let smaller roles carry the rest of the hierarchy.
Do express priority and state through text/icon/dot signals before fill.
donts: Don't use a side-tab (border-l-4 / stripe) on cards or task rows.
Don't mix type voices within one element.
Don't introduce ad-hoc font sizes into product surfaces.
Don't use shadow for in-app depth; stay tonal.
